name: Travis Murdoch
current_role: Founder, President & CEO, Braveheart Bio, Inc. (Nasdaq: BRVE)
profile: Canadian physician-scientist and biotech founder. He co-founded and ran Human Immunology Biosciences (HI-Bio), sold to Biogen in 2024 for $1.15B upfront plus up to $650M in milestones. He now leads Braveheart Bio, a hypertrophic cardiomyopathy company that launched with a $185M Series A in Nov 2025 and listed on Nasdaq in 2026.
interesting_fact: Biogen acquired his first company, HI-Bio, for $1.15B in cash upfront (plus up to $650M in milestones) in 2024, mainly for the antibody felzartamab.
deep_cut_fact: At 16, as a high-school student in an AHFMR Heritage Youth Researcher summer program, he joined the University of Alberta's clinical islet transplantation team (the Edmonton Protocol group). He won the Governor General's medal in 2002 and a 2008 ASTech 'Leaders of Tomorrow' award as a Rhodes Scholar at Oxford.

public_contacts.value: FGS Global (media contact for Braveheart Bio)

notes: Biotech (cardiology), not energy. Best route is the company's media contact at FGS Global.

name: Ivo Jurek
current_role: Chief Executive Officer and Director, Gates Industrial Corporation plc (NYSE: GTES)
profile: Industrial executive who has run Gates, the Denver-based maker of power-transmission belts and fluid-power products, since May 2015, taking it through Blackstone ownership to its 2018 NYSE IPO. He previously ran Eaton Electrical Asia Pacific and Cooper Power Systems/Cooper Bussmann, with earlier roles at International Rectifier and TRW.
interesting_fact: Under Jurek, Gates is moving into AI data-center liquid cooling (hoses and fluid-transfer parts). On the Q2 2026 call he said its data-center business more than doubled and is aiming for $100M-$200M of revenue by 2028.
deep_cut_fact: Before industrial power distribution, he held general-management roles at International Rectifier, the power-semiconductor pioneer, and at auto supplier TRW. He then ran Cooper Power Systems/Cooper Bussmann and later Eaton's electrical business across Asia Pacific (2012-2015).
notes: Strong fit for the energy/data-center angle because of Gates' fast-growing data-center liquid-cooling business. Media contact named in releases: Raquel Fuentes (CorpComm). No personal social accounts verified. His education is not disclosed in the proxy.
